'''Rutherford Justino''' is a [[human]] located at [[Amberwood Keep]] in [[Northwind]]. He was present at a council meeting with [[Lord Amberwood]], [[Sir Hans Dale]] and [[Custodian Lambert]], where at Lambert's behest Lord Amberwood sent word out to any adventurers who could aid Northwind in the dark hours of the [[Blackrock clan|Blackrock]] and [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron]] incursions.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vIuS0DXGY6Y THE HIDDEN AREA BETWEEN STORMWIND AND IRONFORGE: Northwind Zone Trailer — Turtle WoW Patch 1.18]</ref>
